verified_facts.text: At Flybridge, dishes are prepared a few feet from the tables in a glass-enclosed kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each table in his intimate venue feels like a chef’s table, where the masterful culinary team prepares exquisite dishes just a few feet away in a glass-enclosed kitchen.
